message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “flexible” card: it can count as either **1** or **11**, whichever gives the hand the best possible total without busting.  

- **If counting the Ace as 11 keeps the hand ≤ 21, it is treated as 11.**  
- **If counting it as 11 would cause the hand to exceed 21, the Ace automatically reverts to 1.**  

This rule applies to each Ace individually, so a hand with two Aces will usually count one as 11 and the other as 1 (unless both as 1 still gives a better total). The Ace’s value is always chosen to maximize the hand’s score while staying at or below 21.
